leagues.sheets.how.scopes.body: Activity points: every minute of strength training is worth 2 points, and every minute of cardio or maintenance training is worth one point. Groups are ranked by average per active member; neighborhoods and cities by the total points of all members.

leagues.sheets.scope.steps.title: Steps
leagues.sheets.scope.steps.body: Every full 1,000 steps in a day is worth 3 points (for example, 7,800 steps = 21 points). Steps update once an hour.
leagues.sheets.scope.invite.title: A friend who joins, 50+
leagues.sheets.scope.invite.body: A friend who joins through your link adds 50 points to your neighborhood and city, up to 5 friends per week. They don’t count as an active participant until they train.
leagues.sheets.scope.order.title: How ranking works
leagues.sheets.scope.order.body: The official ranking is by average points per active participant, so even a small neighborhood or town can win. The week starts on Sunday, and the month is the calendar month.
leagues.sheets.scope.kmNote: The km shown next to the points are for fun and don’t affect the points or the ranking.
